title: Painting Rainbows
content: It's the final day of Video Week. Today the camera flies through my studio, ending with a demo of how I paint the rainbows in copies of my bookColor and Light.From now through the month of March, if you order a copy ofColor and Lightfrom theDinotopia StoreI'll do a similar sketch in your copy.Tomorrow, I'll announce the "Color and Light" Book Trailer Video Contest.Winners of the 2009 GJ Blogreaders video contestGet Color and Light at the Dinotopia StoreDirect link to video on YouTubeGurneyJourney channel on YouTube
